Lead enterprise platform strategy, governance and optimisation in a major digital transformation program.   Your new company     Join a large and complex organisation undertaking a significant digital transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, service excellence, and continuous improvement, the organisation is investing heavily in modern enterprise platforms and digital capabilities to enhance operational performance and customer outcomes.  This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the future direction of key enterprise technology platforms while partnering with senior stakeholders across the business to drive strategic outcomes.    Your new role     As the Business Technology Platform Owner, you will be responsible for the strategic governance, operational management, and ongoing optimisation of enterprise technology platforms. Acting as the key business representative and platform SME, you will ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while maintaining compliance, security, and operational excellence.  You will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle, developing roadmaps, managing enhancements, driving adoption, and working closely with business, technology, architecture, security, and vendor partners to support organisational objectives.  Key responsibilities include:   
 
 Owning platform strategy, governance, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.   
 Developing and maintaining platform roadmaps aligned to business priorities and transformation goals.   
 Leading the identification, prioritisation, and delivery of platform enhancements and new capabilities.   
 Managing platform performance, service levels, availability, and user adoption.   
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet business and operational requirements.   
 Monitoring risks, compliance obligations, cybersecurity requirements, and platform dependencies.   
 Supporting organisational change, adoption, and optimisation activities.   
 Preparing executive reporting, insights, and performance metrics to support decision-making.   
 Managing vendor relationships and ensuring value is realised from technology investments.   
 
  What you'll need to succeed     To be successful in this role, you will bring experience managing or owning enterprise technology platforms within large and complex environments.  You will have:   
 
 5+ years' experience in a Platform Owner, Platform Manager, Product Owner, Applications Manager, Business Systems Manager, or similar role. 
 Experience with enterprise platforms such as SAP BTP, SAP Enterprise Service Management, Salesforce, Microsoft Power Platform, Oracle Cloud, or comparable technologies. 
 Strong understanding of technology governance, platform lifecycle management, and strategic roadmap development. 
 Demonstrated experience driving platform optimisation, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and business stakeholders. 
 Knowledge of risk management, compliance, cybersecurity, and service management practices. 
 Experience supporting digital transformation, business improvement, and technology-enabled change programs. 
 Strong business analysis and requirements management capability. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to own and shape the future direction of critical enterprise platforms.   
 Exposure to large-scale digital transformation and business improvement initiatives.   
 A highly collaborative environment with significant stakeholder engagement.   
 The chance to influence strategic technology decisions that deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.   
 Competitive remuneration package and long-term career development opportunities.

SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant (ICT Business Analyst – ANZSCO 261111)
Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.
